product_summary: Site (meghmani.com) lists four business verticals: (1) Pigments — phthalocyanine, azo and high-performance pigments under 'Meghafast' brand for printing inks, coatings, plastics; (2) Crop Protection — insecticide technicals (Bifenthrin, Lambda Cyhalothrin, Ethiprole, Dinotefuran, Spiromesifen, Flubendiamide, Beta Cyfluthrin, Cyfluthrin, Flonicamid, Pyriproxyfen, Pymetrozine, Fipronil, Chlorantraniliprole, Cypermethrin, Permethrin, Alpha Cypermethrin, Deltamethrin, Profenofos, Acetamiprid) and herbicides (Triclopyr, 2,4-D); (3) Titanium Dioxide — Anatase and Rutile grades (page states 'KCL setting up largest TiO2 production facility in India'); (4) Crop Nutrition — nano urea liquid fertilizer via wholly owned subsidiary Meghmani Crop Nutrition Ltd (IFFCO technology agreement).
comment: HS 320417 — exact match: phthalocyanine/azo/HPP pigments are the company's core line (claims top-3 global phthalocyanine producer). HS 380891 — exact match: long list of insecticide technicals on the Crop Protection page. HS 380862/380869 — cannot_verify: no product on the site maps to these subheadings (3808.62 = goods of subheading 3808.50 in packings >1 kg; 3808.69 = other; the site lists only technical-grade actives and no formulated-pack description, so the split cannot be confirmed from the catalogue). Missing from the declaration: HS 380893 (herbicides Triclopyr, 2,4-D) — a real product line not covered by the declared codes; HS 320611/320619 (titanium dioxide Anatase/Rutile) — a whole declared business vertical absent from the HS list; HS 3102/3105 (nano urea fertilizer) — product of subsidiary Meghmani Crop Nutrition Ltd, may be invoiced by the subsidiary rather than MOL. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: there is no oil & gas activity on the site — the correct label is specialty chemicals / agrochemicals / pigments. No trader signs: own manufacturing sites (9 facilities per site), own R&D centre in Sanand, own brands (Meghafast). All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was checked in this task; per Rule 3 the HS discrepancies do not reject the company, codes are corrected to the actual product range.
